consumer.scope: GRT37–91 establish the determinant and wall estimates, construct the marked interior-member models, their group and integral frames, and realize the one-parameter series at one auxiliary prime tower. GRT92 distinguishes the common depth four from the comparison of the integral lattices. GRT93–94 construct the smooth arithmetic intersection system. GRT95 proves the complete link between cutoffs under its named hypotheses. GRT96 gives the normalized root limits and quantitative estimate on a matched metric family.

retained_inputs: The selected interior negative member carries the polarized smooth group and two integral section frames of GRT86. Each invocation on another signature or level requires its own identified model, analytic reference flag and marked period parametrization. GRT92 proves the extra conditions on the specified embedded reference, and GRT95 compares the pair of cutoffs on that model.

GRT87–91 construct the marked power series and generic object at a common auxiliary prime tower. To get the entire prescribed arc compare its split uniformization at independent division levels and every compatible embedding, descend its full generic marking, and identify its specialization at the prescribed uniformizer.

GRT93–95 give the full smooth intersection system, projection factors and metric-change formula. GRT96 proves convergence from the common cusp bound and derives the uniform wall estimate from normalized reference word errors. On every required member of the original family one still needs to identify its prescribed regularization with those reference metrics or establish its word estimates at the source time.
